title: Peroxisome Proliferator Activated Receptor-gamma Agonistic Compounds from the Jellyfish-Derived Fungus Cladosporium oxysporum.
authors: Li, Dan-Dan; Luo, Xiaowei; Ying, Wang; La Kim, Eun; Hong, Jongki; Lee, Joon-Hee; Jung, Jee H
one_liner_zh: 该文从水母真菌中分离化合物并研究其PPAR-γ激动活性，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: In our search for peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor (PPAR) agonists, five undescribed compounds, namely two acyclic diterpenes (1 and 2; cladopsol A and cladopsol B), two sesquiterpenes (3 and 4; cladopsol C and cladopsol D), and one C21-ecdysteroid (5; cladopsol E), and 15 known compounds were isolated from the jellyfish-derived fungus - Cladosporium oxysporum. The structures of the undescribed compounds were defined using UV, NMR, HR-ESI-MS, and electronic circular dichroism (ECD) spectroscopy and a modified Mosher's method. Luciferase reporter assay and docking analysis suggested that cladopsol B may function as a PPAR-gamma partial agonist with a potential antidiabetic lead which may evade the side effects of full agonists. Moreover, cladopsol B stimulated glucose uptake in HepG2 cells with an efficacy comparable to that of rosiglitazone, but with less side effect induced by lipid accumulation in 3T3-L1 cells. Therefore, cladopsol B could serve as a molecular skeleton in a study of advanced antidiabetic lead with less side effect.
abstract_zh: 在我们寻找过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体（PPAR）激动剂的过程中，从水母来源真菌——尖孢枝孢菌（Cladosporium oxysporum）中分离得到5个未描述化合物，即两个无环二萜（1和2；cladopsol A和cladopsol B）、两个倍半萜（3和4；cladopsol C和cladopsol D）以及一个C21-蜕皮甾体（5；cladopsol E），以及15个已知化合物。未描述化合物的结构通过紫外光谱（UV）、核磁共振（NMR）、高分辨电喷雾电离质谱（HR-ESI-MS）、电子圆二色谱（ECD）光谱及改良的Mosher方法确定。荧光素酶报告基因实验和对接分析表明，cladopsol B可能作为PPAR-γ部分激动剂，具有潜在的抗糖尿病先导物特性，可能规避完全激动剂的副作用。此外，cladopsol B在HepG2细胞中刺激葡萄糖摄取，其效力与罗格列酮相当，但在3T3-L1细胞中由脂质积累引起的副作用较小。因此，cladopsol B可作为研究具有较少副作用的先进抗糖尿病先导物的分子骨架。
